originalTitle: Will sodium-ion batteries be commercially available before the end of 2024?
title: 2024 年底前是否出现量产并用于商品的钠离子电池？
Were mass-produced sodium-ion cells used in a commercial product by end-2024?
rules: 至少一家企业在 2024 年底前量产钠离子电池，并用于可购买商品；汽车、家庭储能或手机可计入，仅航天或研究用途不算。
At least one company must mass-produce sodium-ion cells and use them in a purchasable product by end-2024; EV, home storage or phones qualify, research-only/space uses do not.
interpretation: 原市场 Yes 表示其商品范围内达标，不必然涉及乘用车客户交付。
Yes applies to this broader commercial-product scope, not necessarily passenger-car delivery.

summary: 这道题覆盖多类商品，平台判定为 Yes。它与限定汽车或指定厂商的题目分开呈现。
This broader product-scope contract resolved Yes and remains separate from vehicle-specific or named-supplier questions.
checklist: 核对电芯量产与商品采用两项条件。
Check cell production and product adoption.
排除仅研究和航天的专用产品。
核对原平台的证据与时间。

stage: 材料与试验 → 产品验证 → 实际应用
Materials and tests → product verification → application
impact: 广义商品市场可以在乘用车之前出现。后续安全与车型资料提供产业背景，但不被用于重建原平台的判断；消费者可购买性与量产范围仍按原规则检查。

Commercial products can precede passenger cars. Later safety and vehicle sources supply context, not a reconstruction of the original resolution; purchase access and production scope follow source rules.
gap: 不同商品类别和截止日期不能混为一个结论。
Product categories and deadlines remain distinct.

title: 钠离子材料、性能与实际交付
Sodium chemistry, performance and delivery
principle: 载流离子与正负极结构决定电池体系；电芯、整包与车型性能有不同分母。安全测试、技术发布和客户交付分别回答不同的问题。
Charge carriers and electrode structure define the chemistry. Cell, pack and vehicle metrics use different boundaries; safety tests, launches and delivery establish different facts.
example: CATL 公告的 175 Wh/kg 是比能量指标，超过 400 km 是车型续航表述；原题还要求零售客户交车。两者不能替代交付凭证。
CATL’s 175 Wh/kg is a specific-energy claim and over 400 km a vehicle claim. The contract additionally requires customer delivery records.
